planning_mode: one open-loop CEM optimisation per window
goal_source: future terminal latent from the contacted audit trajectory

units.translation_error: native pose translation units (millimetres for the SCARED cache)
units.indices: latent/keyframe row indices within the sequence

pose_metric: translation/rotation error of the nearest future recorded latent; not the endpoint of the planned command
retrieval_candidates: strictly future same-sequence latent indices [current_index + 1, sequence_length); current_index is excluded
window_dependence_note: Windows from the same sequence/keyframe overlap; bootstrap intervals are descriptive window-resampling summaries, not case-level inference.
audit_contact_note: The SCARED dataset_7 partition was contacted during model auditing. These values are descriptive audit evidence, not independent confirmation.
